title: قبل صدورها في 19 نوفمبر، روكستار غيمز (Rockstar Games) تنشر عرض الإطلاق لـGrand Theft Auto VI

sources.name: Rockstar Games launch trailer (official file via IGN)

claims.text: Rockstar released the launch trailer unannounced on 15 Oct
Release 19 Nov on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
Jason: got some trouble in the army, didn't leave on the best of terms; no loans for people like him
Music is a new track by Justice

notes: Breaking lane. Pinged 13:37Z; preview 13:54Z; auto-go at 14:10Z if no reply. Template trailer although trailer is past the day cap (the trailer is the news; split also at cap). Breaking profile. IGN 4K official file, x1.0. Avoided intimate scenes 36-37, 43-46, gunfire 53-54, 65-66, 72-73. Grammar review: required edits (character names in Latin) applied; meaning notes taken (يقول not يكشف, Lucia line, Justice attributed to Kotaku and Push Square). DeepL back-check caught تطلق عرض الإطلاق; changed to تنشر/نشرت. Rockstar Newswire was behind a Cloudflare check; release confirmed from the official file and outlets.
